scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,yellow,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/worker" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -ws --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -ws --if-present --
scripts.test:ci: npm run build:shared && npm run test -ws --if-present -- --run
